_doc.purpose: Tier-1 nightly accuracy suite: run on every hot model x every backend. The verdict compares backends with each other (a deviation = a question this backend missed that >=75% of the other backends got right), so items should be stable and unambiguous rather than hard.
_doc.versioning: When adopted, results are keyed by a content hash of this file, not by the 'version' string, so edited questions are never compared with old results.
_doc.default_system_prompt: Used for every item that has no 'system' of its own.

grade_types.number: Last number on the final 'Answer:' line equals 'value' (+/- 'tolerance').
grade_types.one_of: Final answer equals one of 'values' (case/punctuation-insensitive), or contains one as a whole word when the answer is short.
grade_types.json: First JSON value in the reply equals 'value'.
grade_types.python_tests: The last ```python block in the reply is run in a sandboxed subprocess (10 s timeout, no network) followed by 'tests'; pass = exit code 0.
grade_types.tool_call: The reply contains exactly one tool call to 'name' whose arguments match 'args': strings case-insensitive equal, numbers equal, lists compared as case-insensitive sets, {'contains': s} = substring.
grade_types.no_tool_call: The reply makes no tool call and its final answer passes the nested 'answer' grade.

item_fields.messages: Multi-turn items give the full conversation (user/assistant turns); the default system prompt is prepended.
item_fields.needle: Long-context items: the runner builds a filler document of ~target_tokens tokens with 'sentence' inserted at 'depth' (0 = start, 1 = end), then asks 'prompt'. The model is loaded at 'ctx'.
item_fields.tools: OpenAI-format tool definitions sent with the request.
item_fields.max_tokens: Per-item override of the default reply budget.

system_prompt: Answer the question. You may reason briefly, but always end your reply with a final line of the form 'Answer: <answer>' that contains only the answer.
